nodes.label: Fire Hose Water Flow Photo
nodes.description: Close-up macro photograph of a fire hose coupling with water pouring out of the open nozzle end. The hose is bright yellow-green woven fabric with a silver/metal Storz coupling. Water streams dynamically from the opening onto a wet ground surface. Background is blurred (bokeh), showing a textured pavement or ground. Colors are vivid: lime green hose, silver metal fitting, clear-blue water, warm tan/brown ground. Mood is dynamic, action-oriented, suggesting emergency response or firefighting operations. Likely used as a hero or background image for the KFV Freising fire department website.
nodes.subject: firefighting hose with flowing water
